services.desc: Geist Marina offers quality, comfortable pontoons that anyone over 25 years of age can reserve if they have a valid drivers license. Each of our 14 boats seat 12 people. Boats depart at 9:00am, 9:15, 9:30am, 10:00am, 10:30am, or at 2:00pm or 2:15pm. Availability on weekends and holidays can be limited, so be sure to reserve your boat in advance!
